Dynamic Saunas Gracia model DYN 6119 03 FS, a 1 to 2 person full spectrum far infrared sauna designed for near zero EMF performance. The first 205 characters highlight key attributes, including full spectrum infrared heating, near zero EMF carbon heaters, and a compact 1 to 2 person layout ideal for home use.

The interior features a comfortable bench, PureTech carbon heating panels, near infrared elements, an LED control panel, Bluetooth audio, and chromotherapy lighting with red light therapy. The exterior is constructed from Canadian Hemlock wood, bringing a warm spa inspired look to indoor spaces.
Installation is simple with its 120 volt 15 amp plug and play design, requiring no special wiring. The full spectrum infrared technology provides a broader heating profile compared with standard far infrared systems. With supportive lighting, adjustable temperature control, and modern audio integration, the Gracia creates an inviting wellness environment for recovery, relaxation, and daily self care.
